Meta.title: LumiClaw Presence | Campaign walking skeleton
Meta.description: Plan, review, and improve market-specific content from one clear objective.

Shell.journeyLabel: Five steps from objective to improvement
Shell.footer: This is a safe preview: no real account is connected and nothing can be approved or published.

campaigns.title: Start with one clear campaign objective.
campaigns.summary: This is where you will explain what you are promoting, who it is for, and what you want people to do. Content and review will stay anchored to that objective.
campaigns.status: You can create, save, and reopen a demo campaign
campaigns.basis: Data is stored in local PostgreSQL; everything remains public-safe demo seed with no real account.
campaigns.next: Set the objective and call to action, then create the first demo campaign.
campaigns.previewTitle: When ready, this area will summarize

previewItems.first: The outcome you want this campaign to achieve
previewItems.third: The next item that needs your attention

campaigns.technicalBasis: REST, OpenAPI, Idempotency-Key, ETag, and version snapshots share one PostgreSQL control plane.

setup.title: Get the facts ready before writing content.
setup.summary: Your brand story, product value, target market, and supporting proof will live together here so every platform starts from the same truth.
setup.status: The minimal brand, product, market, and evidence matrix can be saved
setup.basis: Only synthetic material is used; draft facts remain visibly owner-blocked instead of being treated as approved.
setup.next: Review the brand matrix and supporting evidence while keeping the demo public-safe.

previewItems.second: Facts and proof that may be used publicly

setup.technicalBasis: Organization, Identity, Brand, Product, Market, ChannelAccount, AccountMandate, and Claim–Evidence now enforce tenant scope.

mission.title: Prepare once, then shape the message for four platforms.
mission.summary: The same brand message will be prepared for X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Xiaohongshu, with an editing area and a preview before anything is shared.
mission.status: Four platform variants can be edited, previewed, and saved
mission.basis: Content comes from synthetic demo seed; no model or platform is called and nothing is approved or published.
mission.next: Edit one platform variant, inspect the preview, and save a new version.
mission.previewTitle: Four platform-specific content versions will appear here

previewItems.first: A suitable expression for each platform
previewItems.second: Content you can edit before review
previewItems.third: A preview before handoff or publication

mission.technicalBasis: Four ArtifactRevisions, CapabilitySnapshots, and the six-role MissionContract reopen consistently; no AgentTeams Mission ran.

review.title: You stay in control before anything is published.
review.summary: Content, supporting facts, and risk notes will appear together so you know exactly what may be shared and why. Nothing moves forward without your confirmation.
review.status: A draft fact still needs owner-supplied evidence
review.basis: The page shows the exact version and digest, but this milestone creates no approval decision or publishing authority.
review.next: Check fact status, evidence count, and version; do not treat demo content as approved.
review.previewTitle: A real review will bring together

previewItems.first: The exact content proposed for sharing
previewItems.second: The facts that support each statement
previewItems.third: Risk notes and decisions that need you

review.technicalBasis: Exact revisions and digests exist; Producer/Auditor, OwnerDecision, ActionGrant, and Receipt remain future governed execution.

learn.title: See what people actually did, then decide what to change.
learn.summary: Comments, interactions, and outcomes will be organized into traceable feedback and suggestions. The system will never rewrite your approved brand facts on its own.
learn.status: Explicitly blocked: there is no real platform feedback
learn.basis: No platform account is connected and no customer, comment, or interaction data has been imported.
learn.next: Confirm that real feedback, system suggestions, and your final decision are clearly separated.
learn.previewTitle: When ready, this area will organize
learn.technicalBasis: Interaction, Outcome, Disposition, and LearningProposal are not implemented or persisted.

Mission.disclaimer: This is an illustration; you will still confirm before anything is shared.
